mapper.select:
select t.id as id, t.user_id as userId, u.nickname as nickname, u.avatar as avatar, t.name as name, t.category as category, t.cover as cover, t.description as description, t.downloads as downloads, t.is_free as isFree, t.pay_type as payType, t.create_time as createTime from sys_resource t left join sys_user u on t.user_id = u.id where t.status = 2
and t.category = #{sysResource.category}
and t.name like concat('%',#{sysResource.name},'%')
order by t.downloads desc ,t.create_time desc
